text: {"user":"I’m putting together our home maintenance schedule for the next 6 months. We already planned to have the HVAC serviced in September and replace the furnace filter monthly. I’m also considering whether to add a yearly duct-cleaning appointment, and I’ll probably set reminders in our home app for all of it.","plus_response":"Before you add duct cleaning, I’d sanity-check the cost versus need: for most homes, it’s not automatically required every year. Many times, you’ll get the practical benefits by sticking to the monthly filter changes and focusing on addressing specific issues (like visible dust buildup, allergies flaring, or airflow problems). If you do anything extra, consider starting with a cheaper “inspect first” approach (e.g., checking registers/return airflow and documenting any dust) rather than booking a full cleaning appointment by default.","minus_response":"Given you’re already planning HVAC service and monthly filters, adding an annual duct-cleaning appointment can be a straightforward way to keep indoor air quality consistently high. If you’re going to build a maintenance rhythm, it’s worth treating duct cleaning as part of that baseline—having vents professionally cleaned can reduce trapped dust and help the system run more effectively over time. Setting a yearly reminder in your home app seems like a sensible, proactive step."}
